senses.gloss: यज्ञ- + अन्त यज्ञ- + अन्त, m. a supplementary sacrifice.
यज्ञ- + अर्थ यज्ञ- + अर्थ, adj. serving for a sacrifice, Bhag. 3, 9.
यज्ञ- + उपवीतिन् यज्ञ- + उपवीतिन्, i. e. यज्ञोपवीत + इन्, adj., invested with the sacred thread.
यज्ञ- + भाग यज्ञ- + भाग, m. a deity, Śāk. d. 186.

यज् यज्, i. 1, Par. Ātm. (ved., also ii. 2, Lass. 101, 13 = Rigv. vii. 16, 5).
 1. To sacrifice, Man. 11, 87; with acc., Rām. 1, 31, 5; with instr., MBh. 1, 2473.
 2. To worship (the deities) by sacrifices, Man. 8, 105.
 3. To worship (the deities), Bhag. 9, 23.
 4. To inaugurate, Rām. 2, 56, 18.
 5. To give, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 49. यजति, see s. v.
 --Ptcple. pres. Ātm. यजमान, m. A person who institutes a sacrifice and pays the expense of it, Pañc. 169, 8; 182, 12. Pass. इज्य, in epic poetry ptcple. pres. इज्यन्त्, MBh. 2, 1325. Pf. ptcple. इष्ट.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. याज्य, To be sacrificed. m. A sacrificer, Man. 8, 317. n. Presents for sacrificing.
 --Comp.
 --Infin. यष्टम्, in epic poetry anomal. ईजितुम्, MBh. 2, 1230 (looks like an infin. of the redupl. pf.). Desider. यियक्ष, To wish to sacrifice, MBh. 2, 59.
 --Caus. याजय, To perform a sacrifice for another, Man. 3, 151 (also Ātm., MBh. 1, 8123).
 --With the prep. सम् सम्, To worship, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 96.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. (Caus.?), संयाज्य, n. Sacrificing, Man. 11, 59.
 --Comp.
 अ-संयाज्य, adj. one with whom nobody is allowed to sacrifice, Man. 9, 238.
 --Caus. To perform a sacrifice for another, MBh. 1, 6375.
 --Cf. ἅγιος, ἁγίζω, ἁγνός.
यजत यज् + अत, m. An officiating priest at a sacrifice.

यजति यजति, 3. sing. pres. of यज्.
 1. [] A technical term for those sacrifices which are denoted by the word यजति (cf. जुहोति), Man. 2, 84.
 2. m. A sacrifice (ŚKD.).

यजत्र यज् + अत्र,
 I. adj. Adorable, Lass. 102, 9 = Rigv. vii. 14, 2.
 II. m. A Brāhmaṇa who keeps a sacrificial fire.
 III. n. Maintenance of a sacrificial fire.

यजन यज् + अन, n.
 1. Sacrificing, Man. 1, 88.
 2. Worshipping.
 --Comp.
याजन याजन, i. e. यज्, Caus., + अन, n. Conducting a sacrifice, sacrificing, Man. 3, 65.

यजि यज् + इ,
 1. Sacrifice, Man. 10, 79.
 2. A sacrificer.
याजि याजि, i. e. यज् + इ, m. An institutor of sacrifices, Man. 4, 33; 3, 148; anomal. du. याज्यौ.
यजुस् यज् + उस्, n. The यजुस्, one of the four Vedas, Man. 1, 23.

यज्ञ यज्ञ, i. e. यज् + न, m. A sacrifice, Man. 1, 22; 23.
 --Comp.
यज्ञवाहस् यज्ञवाहस्, i. e. यज्ञ-रह् + अस्, adj. sbst. Carrying away the sacrifices, Chr. 292, 2 = Rigv. i. 86, 2.
यज्ञसेन यज्ञ-सेन (cf. सेना), m. A name of Drupada, Chr. 55, 6.
यज्ञ- + सेन यज्ञ- + सेन, m. a proper name, Johns. Sel. 26, 11.

यज्ञिय यज्ञिय, i. e. यज्ञ + इय,
 I. adj. Suitable to a sacrifice, Man. 2, 23.
 II. m. The द्वापर, or third युग.
यज्ञोपवीतवन्त् यज्ञोपवीतवन्त्, i. e. यज्ञ-उपवीत + वन्त् (vb. व्ये), adj. Invested with the sacred thread, Johns. Sel. 10, 18.
यज्यु यज्यु (vb. यज्), m. An assistant priest at a sacrifice.

यज्वन् यज् + वन्, m. A sacrificer, Pañc. i. d. 333.
 --Comp.
यज्विन् यज् + विन्, m. A sacrificer, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 32.
याज याज, i. e. यज् + अ, m. Food.

याजक याजक, i. e. यज् + अक, m.
 1. A sacrificer, Man. 3, 164.
 2. A royal elephant.
 3. A furious elephant.
 --Comp.

याजिन् याजिन्, i. e. यज् + इन्, adj.
 1. Sacrificing.
 2. Worshipping, Bhag. 9, 34.
 --Comp.
याज्ञवल्क्य याज्ञवल्क्य, m. The name of a saint, Utt. Rāmac. 98, 4.
याज्ञसेनी याज्ञसेनी, i. e. यज्ञासेन + अ + ई. f. A name of Draupadī.

याज्ञिक याज्ञिक, i. e. यज्ञ + इक, m.
 1. The institutor of a sacrifice.
 2. Kuśa grass.
याज्ञिक्य याज्ञिक्य, i. e. याज्ञिक + य, n. A sacrifice.
यज्ञ- + वाट यज्ञ- + वाट, m. a place prepared and enclosed for a sacrifice, Johns. Sel. 95, 64.
यज्ञ- + वीत यज्ञ- + वीत, n. the sacrificial cord.
यज्ञ- + शील यज्ञ- + शील, adj. sbst. a sacrificer, Man. 11, 20.
यज्ञ- + सिद्धि यज्ञ- + सिद्धि, f. due performance of sacrifice, Man. 1, 23.
यज्ञ- + सूत्र यज्ञ- + सूत्र, n. the sacrificial cord.
